system.description: A colossal city, its alien structures still standing in defiance of time
system.notes:
Mythic | Exploration

A colossal city, its alien structures still standing in defiance of time
Impulses: Confuse intruders, lure them deeper, tempt with secrets

Difficulty: 18

Features

Forgotten Architecture - Passive: The city’s structures hold layers of meaning and function beyond mortal understanding. A PC can make an Instinct or Wits Roll to study the architecture or markings.

  • Critical Success: Learn something about the Syrne purpose and find something useful - map, key, fragment.
  • Success with Hope: Learn something important about the city’s layout or history.
  • Success with Fear: Gain partial information that may lead the PCs deeper into danger.
  • Any Failure: Mark a Stress to find a clue after a tense, exhausting search.

Residual Power - Passive: Any adversary that appears here seems subtly changed by the city’s energy. They gain Advantage on their first attack roll each scene and can mark a Stress to phase through solid walls or barriers within Close range.

Shifting Streets - Action: The city’s corridors shift and reconfigure, sealing paths and opening new ones. Activate a Progress Countdown (4) representing the PCs finding their way through the new layout. On a failure, they stumble into a dangerous area, trigger a trap, or encounter a hostile guardian.

Awakening the Past - Action: Spend a Fear to awaken a piece of Syrneth machinery or summon a guardian. This may activate a massive door, bring a construct to life, or flood an area with dangerous energy. Activate a Progress Countdown (5) as the environment becomes hostile: the PCs must survive or disable the threat before they are overwhelmed.
